Method of Attack: Hijacking a legitimate scheduled task used for backing up registry hives and abusing the associated COM handler to load FlawedGrace RAT
Impacted Systems: SolarWinds Serv-U Managed File Transfer and Serv-U Secure FTP servers with SSH feature enabled
Indicators of Compromise: Hijacked Scheduled Task named RegIdleBackup with altered CLSID in COM handler
Base64 encoded strings in CLSID registry objects
